document:0:637:0.text:
Ever since my memory started slipping, I've been hiding away in this tree hollow.

The terrain makes this place hard for others to reach. And the barriers Bessie and I built make it just as hard for me to escape.

Bessie refuses to give up on me, so she still comes to visit from time to time. But I worry it's too dangerous, so I suggested we keep in touch through a shared journal instead.

I don't want to hurt her. I know exactly what's going to happen to me.

It's only been two days since I saw her, and already her face is blurring in my mind...

I must remind her to reinforce the barriers...

What is... her name again...
document:0:637:0.source_cn:
自从记忆出现问题，我就一直躲在这处树洞中，深居简出。
此处地形复杂，外人难以深入，有了我和蓓丝安合力设置的封锁，我也很难逃脱。
她还不想放弃，经常来探望我，和我说些话。我觉得这样不安全，就提议用交换日记的方式来交流。
因为我不想伤害蓓丝安。我太清楚我会变成什么样了。
上次见面不过两天，我已经不太记得她的模样……
必须跟她说，再加几道封锁……
她……名字是……

say:6:1820805001:1.source_cn: 坚持住啊！穆婆婆昨天又试了一次，她就快成功了！

say:7:1820805002:0.text: Everything will be all right once she moves your soul into a new body! She sent me here to ask what kind of body you'd prefer, so tell me!
say:7:1820805002:0.source_cn: 等她帮你把灵魂转移到其他躯体上，你就不会忘记自己了！她...

say:8:1820805003:0.text: No... Just go, Bessie. I'm done for...
say:8:1820805003:0.source_cn: 不……你走吧，蓓丝安。我已经……没救了……

say:9:1820805004:0.text: No, I'm staying! At least I can keep you company!
say:9:1820805004:0.source_cn: 不行！我要留在这！至少能陪你说说话！

say:10:1820805005:0.text: Bessie... take good care of our <style="highlight">token</style>. Maybe... someday, it'll be the only thing I can still recognize.
say:10:1820805005:0.source_cn: 蓓丝安……好好保管我们两人的<style=highli...

say:11:1820805006:0.text: Go now, before I become... ugh, I don't want to hurt you!
say:11:1820805006:0.source_cn: 快走吧，否则我很快又要……呜，我不想伤害你！

narration:14:18020814:0.text: You hear the strange figure speaking with a muffled voice.
narration:14:18020814:0.source_cn: 你们听见奇异的身影在与一个模糊的声音对话。
narration:14:18020814:0.male: You hear the strange figure speaking with a muffled voice.
narration:14:18020814:0.female: You hear the strange figure speaking with a muffled voice.

cinematic_dialogue:3:1820807001:.text: Hi, Baba Muriel sent me to pick up something of Hilda's.
cinematic_dialogue:3:1820807001:.source_cn: 你好，穆婆婆让我来找希尔达的旧物
cinematic_dialogue:3:1820807001:.male: Hi, Baba Muriel sent me to pick up something of Hilda's.
cinematic_dialogue:3:1820807001:.female: Hi, Baba Muriel sent me to pick up something of Hilda's.

cinematic_dialogue:3:1820807003:.text: I don't think she can hear me.
cinematic_dialogue:3:1820807003:.male: I don't think she can hear me.
cinematic_dialogue:3:1820807003:.female: I don't think she can hear me.

say:6:1820808001:1.text: Go away! An outsider... traveling with a living person? You're not welcome here!
say:6:1820808001:1.source_cn: 滚出去！这里不欢迎你——外来的亡灵，还带着生者！

choice_prompt:7:1820808001.text: Go away! An outsider... traveling with a living person? You're not welcome here!
choice_prompt:7:1820808001.source_cn: 滚出去！这里不欢迎你——外来的亡灵，还带着生者！

say:8:1820808002:1.text: If you dare venture any further, I'll curse you—blinding your eyes and peeling your skin away, inch by inch!
say:8:1820808002:1.source_cn: 再敢往深处走，我就诅咒你们两个！你们的眼睛将变成两团浑...

say:9:1820808003:1.text: That's it? That curse of yours doesn't even hold a candle to the ones cast by the Bantus army.
say:9:1820808003:1.source_cn: 据我所知，班题斯军队的诅咒方式不会这么轻易。

choice_prompt:10:1820808003.text: That's it? That curse of yours doesn't even hold a candle to the ones cast by the Bantus army.
choice_prompt:10:1820808003.source_cn: 据我所知，班题斯军队的诅咒方式不会这么轻易。

say:11:1820808004:1.text: That's my warning! Leave this place at once!
say:11:1820808004:1.source_cn: 这是我的警告！马上离开这里！滚！

say:12:1820808005:1.text: With that, the hostile ghost passes through the barriers and disappears. Before she goes, she even makes sure to destroy your only path ahead.
say:12:1820808005:1.source_cn: 说罢，这个凶恶的幽灵穿透障碍，消失在你们二人面前。离开...
say:12:1820808005:1.male: With that, the hostile ghost passes through the barriers and disappears. Before she goes, she even makes sure to destroy your only path ahead.
say:12:1820808005:1.female: With that, the hostile ghost passes through the barriers and disappears. Before she goes, she even makes sure to destroy your only path ahead.

say:13:1820808006:1.text: She won't listen to reason, and my sword can't touch her.
say:13:1820808006:1.source_cn: 她完全无法交流，我的剑也不能对她造成伤害。
say:13:1820808006:1.male: She won't listen to reason, and my sword can't touch her.
say:13:1820808006:1.female: She won't listen to reason, and my sword can't touch her.

say:14:1820808007:1.text: We'll have to <style="highlight">find another way through</style>. Let's get what Baba Muriel needs and get out of here. I'd rather not deal with that ghost again.
say:14:1820808007:1.male: We'll have to <style="highlight">find another way through</style>. Let's get what Baba Muriel needs and get out of here. I'd rather not deal with that ghost again.
say:14:1820808007:1.female: We'll have to <style="highlight">find another way through</style>. Let's get what Baba Muriel needs and get out of here. I'd rather not deal with that ghost again.

choice:10:0:1.text: Curses usually do things far worse than that.
choice:10:0:1.source_cn: 任何魔法诅咒都没有这么简单
choice:10:0:1.male: Curses usually do things far worse than that.
choice:10:0:1.female: Curses usually do things far worse than that.

choice:10:1:2.text: You're just lashing out, aren't you?
choice:10:1:2.male: You're just lashing out, aren't you?
choice:10:1:2.female: You're just lashing out, aren't you?

narration:16:18020815:0.text: You attempt to speak with Bessie, but she ignores you. Suddenly, a ghost attacks. Thane draws his blade, but it passes harmlessly through the spirit.
narration:16:18020815:0.source_cn: 你们试图与蓓丝安交流，但她毫无反应。此时一个幽灵突然冒...
narration:16:18020815:0.male: You attempt to speak with Bessie, but she ignores you. Suddenly, a ghost attacks. Thane draws his blade, but it passes harmlessly through the spirit.
narration:16:18020815:0.female: You attempt to speak with Bessie, but she ignores you. Suddenly, a ghost attacks. Thane draws his blade, but it passes harmlessly through the spirit.

say:6:1820818001:1.text: What part of "get out" don't you understand?! Leave!
say:6:1820818001:1.source_cn: 你们两个怎么还在这里？滚出去！滚出去！

choice_prompt:7:1820818001.text: What part of "get out" don't you understand?! Leave!
choice_prompt:7:1820818001.source_cn: 你们两个怎么还在这里？滚出去！滚出去！

say:8:1820818002:1.text: We're just helping Baba Muriel to collect something of Hilda's.
say:8:1820818002:1.source_cn: 我们受穆婆婆所托，来这里取希尔达的旧物，仅此而已。

say:9:1820818003:1.text: We won't cause you any trouble if you just leave us be.
say:9:1820818003:1.source_cn: 你若不阻拦，我们也无意为难你。

say:10:1820818004:1.text: ... <shk>You're eyeing Hilda's things?!</shk> How dare you!
say:10:1820818004:1.source_cn: ——<shk>你们要拿希尔达的东西？！</shk>想都别想！

say:11:1820818005:1.text: Get out, now! Take one more step, and I'll end you both!
say:11:1820818005:1.source_cn: 滚出去！别再往前！否则我就直接杀了你们！

say:12:1820818006:1.text: After hurling a threat at you, the ghost disappears beyond the barriers again.
say:12:1820818006:1.source_cn: 放下狠话后，幽灵穿过障碍，再次消失了。

say:15:1820818008:1.text: Communicating with Graveborn and ghosts isn't my strong suit.
say:15:1820818008:1.source_cn: 我不太会和亡灵、幽灵这一类存在沟通。
say:15:1820818008:1.male: Communicating with Graveborn and ghosts isn't my strong suit.
say:15:1820818008:1.female: Communicating with Graveborn and ghosts isn't my strong suit.

say:16:1820818010:1.text: What puzzles me is that while she can react to us, the other ghost, Bessie, seems totally oblivious to our presence.
say:16:1820818010:1.source_cn: 让我感到奇怪的是，她能对我们的行为做出反应。但那个叫蓓...
say:16:1820818010:1.male: What puzzles me is that while she can react to us, the other ghost, Bessie, seems totally oblivious to our presence.
say:16:1820818010:1.female: What puzzles me is that while she can react to us, the other ghost, Bessie, seems totally oblivious to our presence.

choice_prompt:17:1820818010.text: What puzzles me is that while she can react to us, the other ghost, Bessie, seems totally oblivious to our presence.
choice_prompt:17:1820818010.source_cn: 让我感到奇怪的是，她能对我们的行为做出反应。但那个叫蓓丝安的灵魂好像完全感受不到我们的存在。
choice_prompt:17:1820818010.male: What puzzles me is that while she can react to us, the other ghost, Bessie, seems totally oblivious to our presence.
choice_prompt:17:1820818010.female: What puzzles me is that while she can react to us, the other ghost, Bessie, seems totally oblivious to our presence.

say:18:1820818011:1.text: You explain to Thane how the illusions are formed. After all, you came across something similar at the Primal Shrine ten thousand years ago.
say:18:1820818011:1.source_cn: 你向瑟恩解释了记忆幻象的构成——谁让你曾在一万年前的狩...
say:18:1820818011:1.male: You explain to Thane how the illusions are formed. After all, you came across something similar at the Primal Shrine ten thousand years ago.
say:18:1820818011:1.female: You explain to Thane how the illusions are formed. After all, you came across something similar at the Primal Shrine ten thousand years ago.

say:19:1820818012:1.text: Do you mean... for some reason, we're seeing a past event play out again?
say:19:1820818012:1.source_cn: 你是说，曾经在这里发生过的事，出于某种缘由，得以在我们...
say:19:1820818012:1.male: Do you mean... for some reason, we're seeing a past event play out again?
say:19:1820818012:1.female: Do you mean... for some reason, we're seeing a past event play out again?

choice_prompt:20:1820818012.text: Do you mean... for some reason, we're seeing a past event play out again?
choice_prompt:20:1820818012.source_cn: 你是说，曾经在这里发生过的事，出于某种缘由，得以在我们眼前重现？
choice_prompt:20:1820818012.male: Do you mean... for some reason, we're seeing a past event play out again?
choice_prompt:20:1820818012.female: Do you mean... for some reason, we're seeing a past event play out again?

say:21:1820818013:1.text: So the only real ghost here is that woman who's been driving us out.
say:21:1820818013:1.source_cn: 所以真正的幽灵，只有那个一直在阻碍我们深入树洞的女性。
say:21:1820818013:1.male: So the only real ghost here is that woman who's been driving us out.
say:21:1820818013:1.female: So the only real ghost here is that woman who's been driving us out.

say:22:1820818014:1.text: Baba Muriel mentioned nothing about her... why?
say:22:1820818014:1.source_cn: 穆婆婆只提过取旧物，没说过这里还有别人……为什么？
say:22:1820818014:1.male: Baba Muriel mentioned nothing about her... why?
say:22:1820818014:1.female: Baba Muriel mentioned nothing about her... why?

choice_prompt:23:1820818014.text: Baba Muriel mentioned nothing about her... why?
choice_prompt:23:1820818014.source_cn: 穆婆婆只提过取旧物，没说过这里还有别人……为什么？
choice_prompt:23:1820818014.male: Baba Muriel mentioned nothing about her... why?
choice_prompt:23:1820818014.female: Baba Muriel mentioned nothing about her... why?

say:24:1820818015:0.text: Of course you trust Baba Muriel. She's one of your kind.
say:24:1820818015:0.male: Of course you trust Baba Muriel. She's one of your kind.
say:24:1820818015:0.female: Of course you trust Baba Muriel. She's one of your kind.

say:25:1820818016:1.text: Think about it—she never told us exactly what she needed, and that ghost flew off the handle at the mere mention of Hilda...
say:25:1820818016:1.source_cn: 但她连旧物具体是什么都未讲清，而这里的幽灵一听到“希尔...
say:25:1820818016:1.male: Think about it—she never told us exactly what she needed, and that ghost flew off the handle at the mere mention of Hilda...
say:25:1820818016:1.female: Think about it—she never told us exactly what she needed, and that ghost flew off the handle at the mere mention of Hilda...

say:26:1820818017:1.text: Anyway, just stay alert and keep moving.
say:26:1820818017:1.source_cn: 总之，提高警惕，继续前进吧。
say:26:1820818017:1.male: Anyway, just stay alert and keep moving.
say:26:1820818017:1.female: Anyway, just stay alert and keep moving.

choice:23:0:1.text: Maybe even Baba doesn't know about her.
choice:23:0:1.male: Maybe even Baba doesn't know about her.
choice:23:0:1.female: Maybe even Baba doesn't know about her.

choice:23:1:2.text: Maybe Baba didn't consider her a threat?
choice:23:1:2.source_cn: 可能穆婆婆觉得她不是我们的威胁？
choice:23:1:2.male: Maybe Baba didn't consider her a threat?
choice:23:1:2.female: Maybe Baba didn't consider her a threat?

choice:23:2:3.text: She probably forgot about her. Memory overlap, remember?
choice:23:2:3.source_cn: 亡灵容易出现记忆混淆，估计是忘了
choice:23:2:3.male: She probably forgot about her. Memory overlap, remember?
choice:23:2:3.female: She probably forgot about her. Memory overlap, remember?

choice:20:0:1.text: When the full moon rises in Novaris, strange things happen.
choice:20:0:1.source_cn: 诺珐斯的满月会引起异变
choice:20:0:1.male: When the full moon rises in Novaris, strange things happen.
choice:20:0:1.female: When the full moon rises in Novaris, strange things happen.

choice:20:1:2.text: Mana concentration is at its peak during a full moon.
choice:20:1:2.source_cn: 满月时的魔力浓度很高
choice:20:1:2.male: Mana concentration is at its peak during a full moon.
choice:20:1:2.female: Mana concentration is at its peak during a full moon.

choice:17:0:1.text: That's probably an illusion drawn from someone's memory.
choice:17:0:1.male: That's probably an illusion drawn from someone's memory.
choice:17:0:1.female: That's probably an illusion drawn from someone's memory.

choice:14:0:1.text: Your explanation only riled her up even more.
choice:14:0:1.male: Your explanation only riled her up even more.
choice:14:0:1.female: Your explanation only riled her up even more.

say:28:1820818009:0.text: Sorry, I didn't mean to upset her.
say:28:1820818009:0.male: Sorry, I didn't mean to upset her.
say:28:1820818009:0.female: Sorry, I didn't mean to upset her.

choice:14:1:2.text: You really got under her skin just now.
choice:14:1:2.male: You really got under her skin just now.
choice:14:1:2.female: You really got under her skin just now.

choice:7:1:2.text: We're just here to get something!
choice:7:1:2.male: We're just here to get something!
choice:7:1:2.female: We're just here to get something!

narration:29:180208113:0.text: The hornleaf bear finally collapses from exhaustion after chasing you. The ghost that attacked you appears once again.
narration:29:180208113:0.source_cn: 追逐你们的叶角熊终于力竭倒下。此时，那个恐吓你们的幽灵...
narration:29:180208113:0.male: The hornleaf bear finally collapses from exhaustion after chasing you. The ghost that attacked you appears once again.
narration:29:180208113:0.female: The hornleaf bear finally collapses from exhaustion after chasing you. The ghost that attacked you appears once again.

say:6:1820821001:1.text: Don't worry, Hilda. I'll lay some traps in case anyone comes snooping around.
say:6:1820821001:1.source_cn: 别担心，希尔达，我会设好陷阱，以防外人闯入。

say:7:1820821002:1.text: Same goes for the barriers. They should be strong enough to keep you from escaping.
say:7:1820821002:1.source_cn: 还有……障碍我也弄好了，你应该没法轻易逃出去。

say:8:1820821003:1.text: Thanks for doing this for me, Bessie. It's so good to have you around.
say:8:1820821003:1.source_cn: 谢谢你帮我这个忙，蓓丝安。有你真好。

say:9:1820821004:1.text: As long as I stay inside, no one will get hurt... I'll feel lonely, sure, but it's better than regretting what I've done and feeling guilty afterward.
say:9:1820821004:1.source_cn: 只要我能一直呆在树洞里，我就不会跑出去伤害大家了……虽...

say:10:1820821005:1.text: But this isn't what I want, Hilda...

say:11:1820821006:1.text: Why... is this happening to everyone? Forgetting who they are, not recognizing their loved ones, and losing their minds...
say:11:1820821006:1.source_cn: 为什么……大家最后都变成了那样？不记得自己是谁，认不出...

say:12:1820821007:1.text: Such is our fate as Graveborn, Bessie. If we go too long without replacing our limbs, our minds slowly erode until madness sets in.
say:12:1820821007:1.source_cn: 这就是亡灵的宿命，蓓丝安。若是太久没有更换肢体，大家的...

say:13:1820821008:1.text: I knew this would happen the moment Bantus imposed the restriction.
say:13:1820821008:1.source_cn: 从班题斯的禁令下达的那一刻，我就知道会这样了。

say:14:1820821009:1.text: ... I'll come visit whenever I can, Hilda. And I made this new <style="highlight">knife</style> for you.
say:14:1820821009:1.source_cn: ……我会经常来看你的，希尔达。还有，我做了一把新的<s...

say:15:1820821010:1.text: So pretty... It's even got magic in it.
say:15:1820821010:1.source_cn: 好漂亮……上面竟然还有魔力。

say:16:1820821011:1.text: I know your old one broke, so I made this new one more durable. I hope it reminds you of me, your best friend.
say:16:1820821011:1.source_cn: 嗯，我知道你手上的那把已经断了，这把更结实耐用。只要看...

say:17:1820821012:0.text: Maybe... keeping your mind active will help you stay lucid.
say:17:1820821012:0.source_cn: 就是……多这样想想，或许能保持精神稳定？

say:18:1820821013:1.text: Thanks, Bessie... I'll treasure this <style="highlight">token</style> of our friendship.
say:18:1820821013:1.source_cn: 谢谢你，蓓丝安……这是你我之间友谊的<style=hi...

say:19:1820821014:1.text: And... I'll try to hold on to what I remember. I may lose everything else... but never you.
say:19:1820821014:1.source_cn: 还有……我会努力守住我的记忆。无论忘记谁，我都不会忘记你……

say:20:1820821015:1.text: Actually, I'd much rather you remember yourself. You'll always be Hilda... the most important person in my life.
say:20:1820821015:1.source_cn: 比起记住我，我更希望你能记住你自己。你永远是希尔达……...

narration:23:180208114:0.text: You see another memory: separated by an obstacle, Hilda expresses her deep gratitude to Bessie.
narration:23:180208114:0.source_cn: 你们再次看到了记忆幻象——相隔一处障碍，希尔达正向蓓丝...
narration:23:180208114:0.male: You see another memory: separated by an obstacle, Hilda expresses her deep gratitude to Bessie.
narration:23:180208114:0.female: You see another memory: separated by an obstacle, Hilda expresses her deep gratitude to Bessie.

document:0:636:0.text:
(The journal contains two different handwriting styles, one noticeably messier than the other.)

Bessie, I'm sorry for hurting you... Nothing I say now can make it right... I'm so, so sorry.

Don't be too hard on yourself, Hilda! All sorts of strange things can happen under a full moon. I don't blame you.

I couldn't control myself! The voice in my head kept telling me to kill everyone!

You are not alone! The same thing's happening to everyone! None of this is your fault, and I hope you can stay strong.

I don't know how much longer I can keep this up.

Baba Muriel's learning how to replace limbs. Until she figures it out, you just have to hold on!

Don't bother coming anymore, Bessie. I can't even recognize you. There's no hope for me.

Bessie... <s>please, just stay away</s>.

<s>Kill her! Kill her! Kill her!</s>

(The remaining text is illegible)
document:0:636:0.source_cn:
（日志由两种不同的笔记撰写，其中一人的字迹有些凌乱）。
蓓丝安，对不起。我知道说什么都没用，我打伤了你……对不起，真的很对不起。
没关系，希尔达！那天是满月，本就会引起各种异变，我不怪你。
我控制不住自己！我的脑子里一直有个声音在让我杀掉所有人！
你只是出现了和其他人一样的症状！我不怪你，我只求你能够坚持住。
我不知道还能坚持多久了。
穆婆婆正在学习如何更换肢体，在那之前，你一定要坚持住！
别再来了，蓓丝安。我连你都认不出，我已经没救了。
蓓丝安……<s>别再来了</s>
<s>杀了她杀了她杀了她</s>
（后面的字迹无法辨认）
